name: http.rounds.result.explicitNull.400
why: FINDINGS F-24: an EXPLICIT `winner: null` is REJECTED with 400. The validation enum is [undefined, "red", "blue"], so only an OMITTED winner clears a result, even though README/CLAUDE.md document the body as {winner: "red"|"blue"|null}. The Kotlin client is unaffected only because kotlinx.serialization omits default-valued nulls (encodeDefaults is false).
